notablePrerequisites:
Soldevi Adnate does not have summoning sickness.
Nim Deathmantle attached to Great Oak Guardian.
description:
Activate Soldevi Adnate by tapping it and sacrificing Great Oak Guardian, adding an amount of {B} equal to Great Oak Guardian's mana value.
When Great Oak Guardian dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Great Oak Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Great Oak Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.
